info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-billing-dotnet-api-Get Api Order By Order Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Order Retrieval API provides functionality to access detailed information about a specific customer order using its unique order ID. This endpoint allows users to retrieve important order data, including status, items, and customer details. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, customer support systems, and inventory management applications that require real-time order information. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer experience and streamline order management processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific order using its unique ID. You can use this to check the status and details of the order.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the order details.

bearerAuth.description: This authentication scheme allows the use of a bearer token as a means of proving the identity of the user. Clients must include the bearer token in the 'Authorization' header when making requests to the API.
